/home/edgar/Documentos/projetos/forjas/platform-forge/.venv/bin/python3 -c import json, re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import validate as V
p = Path(V.ECONOMY_RECEIPT_PATH)
if not p.is_file():
    print('missing receipt:', p); sys.exit(1)
r = json.loads(p.read_text())
bad = []
if r.get('schema') != V.ECONOMY_RECEIPT_SCHEMA:
    bad.append(('schema', r.get('schema')))
vs = r.get('validated_sha') or ''
ok_sha = subprocess.run(['git','cat-file','-e',
    vs + '^{commit}'], capture_output=True).returncode == 0
if not ok_sha: bad.append(('validated_sha-not-a-commit', vs))
head = subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],
    capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
head1 = subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD~1'],
    capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
if vs not in (head, head1):
    bad.append(('validated_sha-stale', vs, head))
canon = set(V._economy_gate_names())
extra = set(r.get('gates', {})) - canon
if extra: bad.append(('noncanonical-gates', sorted(extra)))
pat = re.compile('tests/' + r'\S+' + r'\.py')
for g, e in r.get('gates', {}).items():
    for t in pat.findall(e.get('reproduce') or ''):
        if not Path(t).is_file():
            bad.append(('dead-reproduce-path', g, t))
if r.get('verdict') not in ('validated', 'failed'):
    bad.append(('verdict', r.get('verdict')))
if bad: print(bad); sys.exit(1)
print('receipt coherent:', len(r['gates']), 'gates,',
      'sha bound')
